purpose: Executable ledger for the `topology-dimension-signature` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Signature rows make Lorentzian, Euclidean, complex-contour, Wick-rotation, causal-order, and signature-independence language auditable but cannot promote a route beyond its state-machine ceiling.

signature_rows.signature_selection_or_contour_rule: Declare whether the route is Lorentzian, Euclidean, complexified, analytically continued, Wick-rotated, CDT-like causality-preserving, causal-set/order-based, nonrelativistic/apparatus-local, or metadata-only; name the contour, continuation, foliation, or causal-structure rule when relevant.
signature_rows.lorentzian_euclidean_or_complex_risk: Failure can appear when Euclidean saddle support is retold as Lorentzian dynamics, causal structure is fixed by construction, Wick rotation is unavailable or nonunique, complex saddles are imported without public-record semantics, or map/detector time is mistaken for spacetime signature.
signature_rows.signature_test: Move across admissible signature/contour/causal-structure choices and check whether the route preserves the same observable quotient, public record, and viability claims; cap signature-independent wording if the continuation or causal rule is route-local.
signature_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer Lorentzian recovery, causal dynamics, Euclidean-to-Lorentzian equivalence, signature independence, or quantum-cosmology closure from one contour, one Wick rotation, one causal discretization, or one map/detector convention.
